# Contract: generated `gh-roadmap/` layer

Generated and committed; **never hand-edited** (Principle X). Same schema as
`architecture/model/elements.yaml` (ADR-0007/0008). Element ids are type-prefixed;
`gh-*` appears only as a prop key.

```yaml
# elements.yaml — GENERATED by import_gh_roadmap.py; do not edit.
- type: Plateau
  id: plat-policy-to-oscal-mvp-1
  name: policy-to-oscal-mvp
  props: {gh-number: "1", gh-state: open, gh-url: "https://github.com/…/milestone/1"}
- type: Deliverable
  id: del-policy-to-oscal-mvp-1-planned
  name: policy-to-oscal-mvp (planned)
  props: {gh-number: "1"}
- type: WorkPackage
  id: wp-markdown-catalogue-converter-gh-44
  name: "#44 Markdown catalogue converter"
  props: {gh-number: "44", gh-state: open, gh-url: "…"}
- type: WorkPackage
  id: wp-vision-single-high-level-archimate-gh-7
  name: "#7 …"
  props: {gh-number: "7", gh-state: closed, gh-url: "…"}
```

```yaml
# relationships.yaml
- {type: Realization, source: wp-markdown-catalogue-converter-gh-44, target: del-policy-to-oscal-mvp-1-planned}
- {type: Realization, source: wp-vision-single-high-level-archimate-gh-7, target: del-policy-to-oscal-mvp-1-planned}
- {type: Realization, source: del-policy-to-oscal-mvp-1-planned, target: plat-policy-to-oscal-mvp-1}
```

When a release names the Plateau (`plat-*` token in its notes) and a closed Work Package
closed before it was published, that Work Package realizes `del-release-<tag-slug>` instead,
and the release Deliverable realizes the Plateau. The `Plateau → bfn-*` Realization appears
only when the milestone description carries an existing `bfn-*` token.

```yaml
# views.yaml — one per milestone
- id: view-plat-policy-to-oscal-mvp-1
  name: "Roadmap — policy-to-oscal-mvp"
  diagram: migration/plat-policy-to-oscal-mvp-1
  viewpoint: implementation_migration
  members: [plat-policy-to-oscal-mvp-1, del-policy-to-oscal-mvp-1-planned, wp-markdown-catalogue-converter-gh-44, wp-vision-single-high-level-archimate-gh-7]
```

## Guarantees

1. Ids: `plat-<title-slug>-<n>`, `del-release-<tag-slug>`, `del-<title-slug>-<n>-planned`, `wp-<title-slug>-gh-<n>`. Stable for the same GitHub object, except that retitling changes the slug; hand-authored references then fail the build with an unknown id.
2. Each list is sorted by `(kind, number)`. Keys are in the fixed order above. No timestamps. A no-change re-run is byte-identical.
3. Only issues carrying their own milestone appear. Drafts and pre-releases are absent.
4. Every Work Package realizes exactly one Deliverable and none realizes a Plateau directly.
5. A planned Deliverable exists only for a milestone with at least one Work Package.
6. Every relationship passes the ArchiMate 3.2 matrix; every `members` id exists.
7. Free text is YAML-escaped by `yaml.safe_dump`; `bfn-*`/`plat-*` tokens are honoured only on exact match.
8. Gaps, the baseline Plateau and Strategy elements are never emitted.

The flow-style one-liners above are illustrative. The importer's real output uses
block style for elements and relationships, so a long title never forces a flow-style
value past the point where `_check_null_keys` would flag it.
